title: Structural and functional insights into an anticancer peptide candidate derived from the EP400NL C-terminal domain.
authors: Liang, Yuxin; Wang, Yuanyuan; Sam, Shuang; Li, Zidong; Khan, Faez Iqbal; Park, Jeong Hyeon
one_liner_zh: 该文研究EP400NL C端结构域的结构与抗癌肽功能，虽用MD模拟但对象为蛋白-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: EP400 N-terminal Like (EP400NL) is a recently characterized transcriptional coactivator implicated in chromatin remodeling and oncogenic signaling. Although its precise function remains incompletely understood, emerging evidence suggests that EP400NL contributes to transcriptional regulatory networks relevant to tumor progression. In this study, we investigated the structural and functional properties of the C-terminal domain (CTD) of EP400NL using bioinformatic and molecular modeling approaches and evaluated the anticancer potential of a peptide derived from this region. Molecular dynamics simulations indicated that the CTD forms an extended, flexible tail that may serve as a functional motif mediating protein-protein interactions. Cell-based assays demonstrated that delivery of the EP400NL CTD peptide or shRNA-mediated targeting of the corresponding RNA region suppresses cancer cell proliferation and clonogenicity, supporting a potential inhibitory role of this domain in tumor growth and survival. Collectively, these findings identify the EP400NL CTD as a promising structural motif for anticancer peptide development.
abstract_zh: EP400 N末端样蛋白（EP400NL）是一种近期被表征的转录共激活因子，参与染色质重塑和致癌信号传导。尽管其精确功能尚未完全明了，但新出现的证据表明，EP400NL有助于与肿瘤进展相关的转录调控网络。在本研究中，我们利用生物信息学和分子建模方法探讨了EP400NL C末端结构域（CTD）的结构与功能特性，并评估了源自该区域的一种肽的抗癌潜力。分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟表明，CTD形成一条延伸的柔性尾部，可能作为介导蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用的功能基序。基于细胞的实验证明，递送EP400NL CTD肽或通过shRNA介导靶向相应RNA区域可抑制癌细胞增殖和克隆形成能力，支持该结构域在肿瘤生长和存活中可能发挥抑制作用。总体而言，这些发现将EP400NL CTD识别为一种有前景的抗癌肽开发结构基序。
